https://maersk.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Mae.title: Intern- MGF
https://maersk.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com/Mae.desc:
About the Role We are looking for motivated interns to support on our Maersk Ground Freight Team. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle inbound and outbound communications with customers, client personnel, delivery teams, carrier partners, and internal stakeholders via phone, email, and SMS. 
Assess customer needs and provide timely, accurate, and effective solutions to delivery-related inquiries, issues, and exceptions. 
Troubleshoot delivery exceptions in coordination with delivery and carrier teams, including customer availability concerns, route challenges, locating delivery addresses, go-backs, and communicating revised delivery timeframes. 
 Monitor assigned delivery routes and teams in real time to support adherence to planned schedules, on time performance, and successful delivery execution. 
Provide real-time route status updates and proactively communicate delivery exceptions, delays, and risks to relevant stakeholders. 
Report and escalate route and delivery issues as appropriate, coordinating with field operations, carrier teams, and other stakeholders to drive timely resolution. 
Collaborate with field operations and carrier partners to resolve operational challenges and maintain service continuity. 
Deliver intraday updates and reports on route performance, delivery status, and operational exceptions. 
Conduct proactive follow-up with customers following exception-based resolutions to confirm satisfaction and ensure a positive customer experience. 
Support carrier compliance with operational standards, service expectations, and customer requirements. 
Meet defined customer service, dispatch, and operational KPI targets within established service levels. 
Apply company values, policies, and service standards in all customer and stakeholder interactions. 
Students should be currently pursuing or graduated in Bachelor's degree and okay to work in US time shifts and can start immediately. 
 Maersk is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we embrace different styles of thinking. Maersk is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applicants without regard to race, colour, gender, sex, age, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, pregnancy or parental leave, veteran status, gender identity, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements. 
 We are happy to support your need for any adjustments during the application and hiring process. If you need special assistance or an accommodation to use our website, apply for a position, or to perform a job, please contact us by emailing accommodationrequests@maersk.com .
